text: select id, email from users where created_at >= now() - interval '7 days';

update carts set total = total + 4.50 where id = $1 returning total;

select u.name, o.total from users u join orders o on o.user_id = u.id;
select rank() over (partition by team_id order by score desc) from picks;
with recent as (select * from logs limit 50) select count(*) from recent;
create index concurrently idx_orders_user on orders (user_id, created_at);
select coalesce(nullif(nickname, ''), name) as display from members;
delete from sessions where expires_at < now() - interval '30 days';
select jsonb_build_object('id', id, 'tags', tags) from posts limit 10;

select
    id,
    email,
    created_at
from users
where active = true
order by created_at desc
limit 20;

select u.id, u.email, count(o.id) as orders
from users u
left join orders o on o.user_id = u.id
group by u.id, u.email
having count(o.id) > 0
order by orders desc;

with recent_orders as (
    select user_id, sum(total) as spend
    from orders
    where created_at >= now() - interval '30 days'
    group by user_id
)
select u.email, r.spend
from recent_orders r
join users u on u.id = r.user_id
where r.spend > 100
order by r.spend desc;

insert into daily_stats (day, user_id, minutes)
values (current_date, $1, $2)
on conflict (day, user_id)
do update set minutes = daily_stats.minutes + excluded.minutes
returning day, minutes;

select
    user_id,
    day,
    wpm,
    avg(wpm) over (
        partition by user_id order by day
        rows between 6 preceding and current row
    ) as wpm_7d,
    rank() over (partition by day order by wpm desc) as day_rank
from daily_stats
where day >= current_date - interval '90 days';

select
    e.id,
    e.payload ->> 'skill_id' as skill_id,
    (e.payload -> 'latency' ->> 'ms')::int as latency_ms
from events e
where e.payload @> '{"kind": "keystroke"}'::jsonb
  and (e.payload ->> 'correct')::boolean is false
order by latency_ms desc
limit 50;
select id, lag(wpm) over (order by day) as prev_wpm from daily_stats;
with d as (select generate_series(0, 6) g) select current_date - g from d;
select distinct on (user_id) user_id, wpm from sessions order by user_id;
select array_agg(distinct lang order by lang) from corpus_entries;
select string_agg(tag, ', ' order by tag) as tags from entry_tags;
select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', id, 'wpm', wpm)) from sessions;
update events set payload = jsonb_set(payload, '{seen}', 'true') where id = $1;
select date_trunc('week', created_at) as wk, count(*) from sessions group by wk;
select * from sessions s, lateral top_skills(s.id) t where t.rank <= 3;
insert into days (date) values (current_date) on conflict (date) do nothing;
select case when wpm > 60 then 'fast' else 'slow' end as tier from stats;
create index idx_events_payload on events using gin (payload jsonb_path_ops);
explain analyze select * from keystroke_events where session_id = $1;
select sum(latency_ms) filter (where not correct) as lost_ms from events;
select percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by latency_ms) from events;
select id, row_number() over (partition by lang order by wpm desc) from runs;
select coalesce(sum(minutes), 0) from days where date > current_date - 30;
delete from keystroke_events where ts < now() - interval '90 days' returning id;
select u.email from users u left join orders o on o.user_id = u.id limit 25;
select payload -> 'latency' ->> 'ms' as ms from events limit 100;
alter table sessions add column completed boolean not null default false;
select lang, count(*) from corpus_entries group by lang having count(*) >= 45;
select generate_series(current_date - interval '6 days', current_date, '1 day');
create unique index on days (date) where session_completed is true;
select nth_value(wpm, 2) over (order by day desc) from daily_stats;
select id from skills order by ewma_latency_ms desc nulls last limit 12;
update skills set samples = samples + 1 where id = any($1::text[]);
select to_char(day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as day, wpm from daily_stats limit 30;
select count(*) over () as total, id from sessions order by started_at;
insert into tags (name) select unnest($1::text[]) on conflict do nothing;
select avg(wpm)::numeric(5, 1) from sessions where mode = 'code';
select jsonb_path_query(payload, '$.keys[*].layer') from events limit 5;

select
    date_trunc('day', started_at)::date as day,
    count(*) as runs,
    round(avg(accuracy) * 100, 1) as accuracy_pct
from sessions
where started_at >= now() - interval '30 days'
group by day
order by day;

select
    s.mode,
    count(*) as runs,
    round(avg(s.wpm)::numeric, 1) as avg_wpm
from sessions s
where s.ended_at >= now() - interval '14 days'
group by s.mode
order by runs desc;

with spine as (
    select generate_series(
        current_date - interval '13 days',
        current_date,
        interval '1 day'
    )::date as day
)
select
    spine.day,
    coalesce(d.minutes, 0) as minutes,
    coalesce(d.session_completed, false) as done
from spine
left join days d on d.date = spine.day
order by spine.day;

insert into skills (id, layer, key_id, ewma_error, ewma_latency_ms, samples)
values ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, 1)
on conflict (id) do update
set ewma_error = 0.8 * skills.ewma_error + 0.2 * excluded.ewma_error,
    ewma_latency_ms = 0.7 * skills.ewma_latency_ms + 0.3 * excluded.ewma_latency_ms,
    samples = skills.samples + 1,
    updated_at = now()
returning id, samples, ewma_latency_ms;

with ranked as (
    select
        skill_id,
        latency_ms,
        row_number() over (partition by skill_id order by ts desc) as recency,
        percent_rank() over (order by latency_ms) as pct
    from keystroke_events
    where correct is true
)
select r.skill_id, s.layer, round(avg(r.latency_ms), 0) as recent_ms
from ranked r
join skills s on s.id = r.skill_id
where r.recency <= 20
group by r.skill_id, s.layer
order by recent_ms desc
limit 15;

with recursive tree as (
    select id, parent_id, name, 1 as depth
    from stages
    where parent_id is null
    union all
    select s.id, s.parent_id, s.name, t.depth + 1
    from stages s
    join tree t on t.id = s.parent_id
)
select t.depth, t.name, gate.threshold
from tree t
left join lateral (
    select threshold
    from mastery_gates g
    where g.stage_id = t.id
    order by g.created_at desc
    limit 1
) gate on true
order by t.depth, t.name;

select distinct on (e.session_id)
    e.session_id,
    e.payload ->> 'layer' as layer,
    jsonb_agg(e.payload -> 'key' order by e.ts) filter (
        where (e.payload ->> 'correct')::boolean is false
    ) over (partition by e.session_id) as misses
from keystroke_events e
where e.ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
  and e.payload @> '{"kind": "chord"}'::jsonb
order by e.session_id, e.ts desc;
